decisions.reason: The source message separately supplies NCA/NH and Site 286R dates, but those changes are already fully represented by the candidate's message-24 MODIFY.
The source changes allocated budgets, dates, and weeks served but provides no service weekdays or session time slots for either new site.
The source does not state that the signature requirement or its placement applies to NCA/NH or Site 286R.
The revised budgets, dates, and weeks-served value do not necessarily alter the existing actual-session-count compensation formula or its recorded HPI values.
The seven-week correction is an independent clause already fully represented by the candidate's message-24 INTRODUCE; the allocated-budget change requires no additional modification.
